summary: Normalizes a copy of the input string via sub_589901, then tests membership in a hash table through sub_587C20 against the head dword_5CC79C. On a miss it extends the string at its terminator with the raw 4-byte hash head value dword_5CC79C followed by the single-byte value byte_5CC7A0 to form a compound key. The resulting string is passed to CollisionNodeAllocator and its result returned. A NULL input returns -1 immediately.

operations.description: Guard on the input pointer a1: when it is NULL, return -1 immediately without processing.
Copy the input string into the 80-byte local buffer SrcStr, advancing both pointers and including the terminating NUL byte.
Call sub_589901 on the local copy SrcStr to normalize the string.
Call sub_587C20(SrcStr, &dword_5CC79C) to test whether the normalized string is already present in the hash table addressed by dword_5CC79C.
When the lookup returns 0 (string not found), build a compound key: write the raw 4-byte value dword_5CC79C at the string terminator, then the single byte byte_5CC7A0 immediately after it.
Return CollisionNodeAllocator(SrcStr), handing the (possibly extended) string to the collision node allocator and propagating its result.
